summary: Deploy run 38723618679 planned twelve deletions after a feature branch provisioned the shared-data bucket, account token, five Infisical secrets and five version records in fleet state before main declared them. The stateful policy correctly refused to delete cloudflare_r2_bucket.shared_data. Main must explicitly forget all four resource addresses with destroy = false, preserving both stored data and working credentials rather than deleting resources owned by the feature branch.
